verses.text: A song of ascents. People who trust the LORD are like Mount Zion. It can’t be shaken. It stands forever.
Just as mountains surround Jerusalem, the LORD surrounds his people from now on and forever.
The scepter of the wicked won’t stay over the land given to the righteous, so the righteous won’t turn their own hands to evil.
LORD, do good to people who do good, to those whose hearts are upright.
But the people who turn off onto crooked paths, the LORD will lead away with those who do evil. Peace be on Israel.
